title: Forty pails, morning
logline: The lunchroom shelf on a morning in 1994: forty lunch pails in a row, full, every one different. The page the one-pail page will empty. Era I spotting in the dents.

panels.composition: A long shelf in a mill lunchroom with forty lunch pails in a row, every one a different shape and color, dents and stickers, morning light from a high window, no people.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a long shelf in a mill lunchroom holding forty lunch pails in a row every one a different shape with dents and stickers, morning light from a high window, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
